This is not an EVAL closeness metric and not a binding result. Quantiles use the implemented nearest-rank index int(round(p * (n - 1))) on values sorted ascending. No confidence interval is defined. Directions on nearest_train_normalized_edit_distance and maximum_edit_similarity_to_train describe novelty only and are not extra votes for overall generator quality.

metrics.denominator_and_filters: Length of the longer of the valid sequence and that TRAIN core. Quantiles are taken over valid rows. Invalid rows are excluded.

blocking_items.statement: parsed_outputs remains the legacy M4 predicate and is not renamed. successfully_parsed_outputs counts nonempty extracted sequences before A/C/G/U filtering. An alphabet-invalid nonempty output is parsed and is not valid. An empty or unparseable output is not successfully parsed.
exact_hit_rate is the only requested-length exact-hit metric. requested_length_exact_hit_rate is a presentation of that metric and is not a second metric.
maximum_identity_to_TRAIN is retired and is not an alias. maximum_edit_similarity_to_train remains the code metric. It is an edit-based similarity, not a sequence identity.
mfe_per_nt remains the generator metric. It is not the AptaRank normalized-MFE component. mfe_per_nucleotide is not a second metric.
0.90 and 0.50 are historical references, not decisions. B0 exact hit is not_applicable. Requested length 37 or 36 is not assigned in order to compute a B0 rate.

pooled_gc_fraction is implemented as (count_G + count_C) / total canonical bases on the nucleotide_fractions population, with duplicates retained. Direction is not_applicable. No threshold or preferred range is defined.

Generated-sequence clustering, structure clustering, singleton fraction, largest-cluster share, Shannon diversity, effective-cluster count, and threshold sensitivity stay deferred. They are not required generator output. No threshold, including a corpus 90% threshold, is imported. They are not closeness votes. largest_duplicate_share remains the exact-string guardrail.
Representation-space analysis stays deferred. No representation model, encoder, distance, or kernel is added during this evaluation.

Three closeness metrics are implemented only for runtime role synthetic_eval_stand_in. They become EVAL metrics only after the formal M9C unlock supplies unique EVAL cores. Runtime role EVAL is refused. The metrics are reported separately and are never combined. A distributional similarity does not demonstrate binding, affinity, selectivity, inhibition, or NDM-1-specific learning.
TRAIN nucleotide total variation stays nested descriptive output. It is not a separate metric id and it is not a closeness vote.
TRAIN dinucleotide total variation stays nested descriptive output. It is not a separate metric id and it is not a closeness vote.
No generator confidence interval, hypothesis test, or bootstrap is specified. An observed range across D1 training seeds is not a confidence interval.
Production TRAIN is not loaded. Only a synthetic TRAIN collection inside a GEP-2 fixture is accepted, and that collection is not production TRAIN.
ViennaRNA is not called. Structure metrics run only when a deterministic synthetic fold is injected. No new MFE formula is defined, and mfe_per_nt is not the AptaRank normalized-MFE component.

Production ViennaRNA settings are not yet fully pinned. This is a blocking pre-M9C item and requires an explicit pin or a scope decision. This package does not invent temperature, dangle, salt, or other folding settings. Structure metrics remain synthetic-injection-only.

A pure synthetic schedule mapper normalizes producer keys and verifies arithmetic. Production schedules are not loaded. A 1,000-attempt diagnostic schedule is not the 30,000-attempt final D1 budget, and this package does not declare that budget satisfied.

The synthetic boundary mapper stores one integer producer field seed as empirical_null_seed, rejects a remaining generic seed, and does not create training_seed. Exactly one B2 seed is required. This package does not assume that a production run used seed 42.

provenance_manifest_contract.replenishment_prohibited_statement: Replenishment is prohibited. Invalid or duplicate attempts are not filtered, deduplicated, truncated, padded, topped up, replaced, or replenished.

multiplicity_histogram.value: number of distinct valid sequences having that multiplicity

novelty_direction_statement: Directions on nearest_train_normalized_edit_distance and maximum_edit_similarity_to_train describe novelty only and are not extra votes for overall generator quality.
